S2 + methyl acetate -> S/methyl acetate + S

method: MACE-POLAR-M, fixed GFN2-refined molecular geometries; electronic gas reactions
scope: Exploratory self-association competition. Not liquid chemical potentials or polymer/surface free energy.
caveats: Carbonyl solvation can cancel between adhered/free chains
Entropy, multiple solvent partners, many-body liquid structure and oxide selectivity are absent
